sourceDetails.careInstructions: Dust the frame with a dry, soft cloth and wipe occasionally with a lightly damp cloth, drying at once. Brush the velvet in one direction to keep the pile even, and blot spills rather than rubbing. Wipe the brass ferrules with a dry cloth; avoid abrasive or solvent-based cleaners on any part of the piece.

Round top with a softly eased edge
Base of three curved panels joined in a central Y spine
Arched cut-outs between panels lighten the form
Continuous grain wrapped across the outer faces of the base
Small recessed floor pads under each panel
Top options: wood, glass, metal or marble

Side panels wrapped in textured upholstery with contrast saddle stitching
Slim brass-finished rail across the front edge of the glass shelf

Stone-look surface over the drawer for daily use
Four turned, tapered legs in a brushed brass finish
Matte open-grain polish

Two curved panel bases, half-round in plan, set inboard to leave an overhang at both ends
Open span between the two bases

Round stone top with a straight, squared edge and visible thickness
Base of curved metal half-discs, with the crescents rising above the tabletop line

Bronze-toned metal finish across the entire base
